# GYMEZY

> GYMEZY (https://gymezy.com) is Chennai's premier fitness technology platform and multi-gym network. It connects fitness enthusiasts with verified local gyms, flexible daily drop-in passes, multi-gym memberships, and certified 1-on-1 personal trainers with zero lock-in contracts.

## Overview

GYMEZY eliminates traditional gym friction—such as expensive annual lock-ins, admission fees, and rigid location restrictions. Through the GYMEZY mobile app and web platform, users can explore gyms near them, view transparent equipment and amenity details, book single-day passes or flexible memberships, and enter instantly using a dynamic OTP or QR code.

For extended context and complete data tables, see [llms-full.txt](https://gymezy.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Offerings

- **Pay-Per-Session Daily Passes**: Work out at top-tier fitness centres starting at ₹149 to ₹299 per day. Instant 24-hour digital access without joining fees.
- **Flexible Multi-Duration Memberships**: 1, 3, 6, and 12-month memberships with multi-gym flexibility across Chennai.
- **Certified 1-on-1 Personal Coaches**: Verified personal trainers specializing in fat loss, muscle building, strength training, HIIT, and customized diet plans.
- **Specialized Studio Classes**: Group bookings for Yoga, Zumba Fitness, Cross-training, and Boxing/MMA.
- **Contactless QR/OTP Check-in**: Queue-free front desk validation using encrypted, rotating digital codes.
- **Gym Partner Operating System**: SaaS tool for gym owners to manage memberships, monetize unutilized off-peak capacity, and accept walk-in athletes.

## Geographic Coverage (Chennai & Tamil Nadu)

GYMEZY operates primarily in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, with active partner fitness facilities across:
- Moulivakkam (Headquarters)
- Porur & Ramapuram
- Anna Nagar & Shenoy Nagar
- T. Nagar & Kodambakkam
- Velachery & Madipakkam
- OMR (Old Mahabalipuram Road) & Thoraipakkam
- Guindy & Alandur
- Nungambakkam & Alwarpet
- Adyar & Besant Nagar
- Tambaram & Chromepet

## Key Pages & Endpoints

- [Homepage](https://gymezy.com/): Official landing page, brand mission, and pass discovery.
- [For Customers](https://gymezy.com/customers): Daily pass booking, multi-gym pass options, mobile app download.
- [For Gym Owners](https://gymezy.com/gym-owners): Free facility listing, off-peak monetization, QR attendance system.
- [For Personal Trainers](https://gymezy.com/trainers): Trainer onboarding, client booking, schedule management.
- [About GYMEZY](https://gymezy.com/about): Company history, mission, leadership, and contact details.
